publicRoute.purpose: bounded public Cloudflare speedtest payload, no VOD/provider account I/O

limits: Sequential trials at different times, not randomized or simultaneous.
Whole-file bitrate is an average including tracks/container, not instantaneous media demand.
Legacy minimal user-agent differs from production default on the first three trials and the explicit control.
Short-range and full-file-range requests differ; only later full-range requests reproduce the continuous request bounds.
HTTP 206, body hashes and ffprobe do not certify full playback or audible quality.
